baseline.method: Original direct Williams fit of full measured nodemap; no independent stress truth

reference_role: published-method baseline; agreement is not proof of physical accuracy
threshold_rationale: Independent full original/local maximum stress discrepancy 1.53e-12 MPa and intensity discrepancy 3.2e-14 MPa sqrt(m). Bounds allow float32 serialization while rejecting 1% scale errors.
nrmse_definition: RMS error divided by max(reference)-min(reference), separately for each entire declared array.
